- Added `<meta name="theme-color" content="#0d0d1a">`
- Added `autocomplete` attributes to all form inputs

- `.card`: translucent glass treatment — `rgba(26,26,46,0.6)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)` + `border-radius: 12px` + `box-shadow`
- `@supports not (backdrop-filter)` fallback to solid `#1a1a2e`
- Inputs: `min-height: 44px`, dark translucent background, rounded 8px, focus glow in accent color
- Color input: full-width, `min-height: 44px`
- Button: `min-height: 44px`, `font-weight: 600`, `border-radius: 8px`, `transform: scale(0.98)` on active, 200ms transitions
- `.error`: left-border indicator, hidden when empty
- `h1`/`h2`: white with letter-spacing
